verdict.rationale: Clerk's own marketing explicitly claims built-in ML-based bot detection for sign-ups and brute-force prevention on OTP delivery, plus MFA as a second factor which mitigates credential-stuffing/brute-force risk on sign-in flows. However, all evidence is vendor-stated with no independent security testing, no explicit mention of credential-stuffing-specific defenses (e.g., breached-password detection), and bot-detection is gated behind a paid tier. Missing for 10: independent/third-party verification of bot-detection efficacy, explicit credential-stuffing protection details, and confirmation these protections are available on the free tier.
